line: Crowley on Atu V: the letter Vau, Taurus, the uniting of microcosm and macrocosm, and the aeon of Horus (pdf p68, p69, p74).

sections.title: Letter and sign
sections.line: Crowley refers the card to the letter Vau, a Nail, and to Taurus (pdf p68).

quotes.quote: This card is referred to the letter Vau, which means a Nail;
The card is referred to Taurus; therefore the Throne of the Hierophant is surrounded

sections.title: The arcanum, the Child and the Tree
sections.line: Crowley on the uniting of the microcosm with the macrocosm (pdf p68), the aeon of Horus, of the Child (pdf p69), and the Hierophant on the other side of the Tree of Life (pdf p74).

quotes.quote: But the main reference is to the particular arcanum which is the principal business, the essential, of all magical work; the uniting of the microcosm with the macrocosm.
It is the aeon of Horus, of the Child.
The Hierophant, which, on the other side of the Tree of Life, brings down the fire of Chokmah.
